# We Took Care of Their Print, So They Could Take Care of the People


## By taking print management off its plate, we helped a U.S. State Government focus on what truly matters: public services.


### Proven Results


[Xerox® Print as a Service](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/digital-printing/print-as-a-service) is a unified, cloud-based model that shifts government responsibilities from the burdens of device ownership to an agile, asset-light framework.


### The Challenge


-


**Fragmented print workflows** across departments led to inefficiencies, limited visibility, and increased administrative burden.


-


**Rigid procurement, security, and budget demands** in the public sector complicated the swift acquisition of printing services while maintaining compliance.


-


**Limited IT resources** and rapidly evolving print technology made it challenging to manage vendors, control costs and support secure digital-to-physical workflows.


### The Solution


-


A centralized cloud portal for secure print submission, tracking, and management across all locations.


-


Intelligent job routing automatically optimized costs, production capacity and turnaround time.


-


A hybrid production network leveraged both in-house capabilities and a Xerox-managed network of certified partner facilities for maximum flexibility.


-


Real-time visibility and analytics improved procurement oversight, transparency, and spend management.


-


On-demand digital production minimized inventory, waste, and costs while enabling personalized, brand-consistent communications.


### The Results


-


Improved visibility and control for enterprise print operations across all departments.


-


Significant reduction in administrative effort through automated workflows and intelligent job routing.


-


Increased cost efficiency achieved through optimized sourcing, competitive bidding, and on-demand production by leveraging the latest technologies within our print network.


-


Enhanced security, compliance, and procurement oversight across departments.


[Read the full article about Xerox Print as a Service tailored for the public sector](https://insider.govtech.com/california/sponsored/modernizing-californias-public-sector-workflows-with-xerox)
